summary: Denise McLean, 45, of Wylie, Texas, fell to her death at Royal Gorge Bridge and Park; last seen at an observation point on the north side of the gorge near the north entrance parking area (northeast of the Royal Gorge Bridge), then reported missing Monday night; Cañon City PD searched but suspended overnight due to darkness and dangerous terrain; the Fremont County Search and Rescue team located her body Tuesday morning at 9 a.m. on a cliff face ~400 feet below the observation point.
location: Royal Gorge Bridge and Park, north-side observation point near north entrance parking area
responding_agency: Fremont County Search and Rescue; Cañon City Police Department
notes: Date approximate: fall occurred on/before the Monday-night missing report (2015-06-29 verified Monday; 2015-06-30 verified Tuesday); body found by Fremont County SAR on 2015-06-30 ~9 a.m. Fremont County coroner ruled the ~400-foot fall accidental (fell or slipped from rocks beside the gorge).
